title: ARSIA Broker Relay Audit Record
description: Audit record produced by a Compliance Broker for every message it relays. Captures relay metadata for compliance and audit purposes without storing the message payload. Defined in ARSIA-Routing.md §7.4; normative field requirements in §7.3 Rule 7.

audit_type.description: Fixed value identifying this as a broker relay audit record. Per ARSIA-Routing.md §7.4.

allOf.description: UUID v4 unique to this relay operation. Per ARSIA-Routing.md §7.4 and §7.3 Rule 7.
The id field of the relayed ARSIA message (UUID v4). Per ARSIA-Routing.md §7.4 and §7.3 Rule 7.

from_agent.description: The from field of the relayed message. Per ARSIA-Routing.md §7.4 and §7.3 Rule 7.

to_agent.description: The to field of the relayed message. Per ARSIA-Routing.md §7.4 and §7.3 Rule 7.

broker_agent_id.description: The broker's own agent-id. Per ARSIA-Routing.md §7.4 and §7.3 Rule 7.

allOf.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or supranational identifier (e.g. 'EU') for the data residency zone this relay satisfies. Per ARSIA-Routing.md §7.4.
RFC 3339 timestamp with millisecond precision and UTC designator, recording when the relay occurred. Per ARSIA-Routing.md §7.4 and §7.3 Rule 7.

SHA-256 hash (lowercase hex) of the relayed message payload. When the message is encrypted (security.encrypted=true), this is the hash of the JWE Compact Serialization string (UTF-8 bytes). When unencrypted, this is the hash of the RFC 8785 canonicalized payload object. The broker stores only the hash, never the payload contents (§7.3 Rule 4). Per ARSIA-Routing.md §7.4 and §7.3 Rule 7.

relay_latency_ms.description: Time in milliseconds from message receipt to forward initiation. Per ARSIA-Routing.md §7.4.

forwarding_result.description: Outcome of the relay operation. Per ARSIA-Routing.md §7.4.
